fullText:
A high-schooler in London, spent about two weeks with us and shipped two projects our experienced team had kept postponing. He worked more than eight hours a day.

I was surprised by how much he (Ayush) got done.

Ayush rebuilt the AI Crawl Checker on our marketing site through four pull requests, all four of which were merged. It now runs against a live API with tests and CI.

He also built Competitor Watch, a standalone Next.js service on Supabase with a Vercel cron job.

It checks competitor blogs, changelogs and pricing pages, compares each page with its previous snapshot, sends meaningful changes to Slack, and shows them on a dashboard.

Ayush moved fast partly because he hadn't yet absorbed which tasks engineers are expected to find hard. He asked the question, got an answer and kept going.

The fetching and diffing were straightforward. Deciding whether a pricing edit or changelog entry was interesting still needed the team's judgement.

On his own time and accounts, Ayush is building an app that turns the random links and posts people save into things you actually do, like keeping the recipe you saw on YouTube last week with the original link and resurfacing both when they are useful.

It is already running on his phone: he can share a link into it, save it, and avoid duplicates. He's now testing it with family and friends.

Motivated young builders can do remarkable things now, especially with AI. You have to involve them, give them real tasks that matter and guide them.

When someone is motivated and gets things done, a lack of experience isn't the obstacle people assume it is.

fullText:
Cloudflare 今天开源了 Cloudflare OS，正式改变了saas的范式，宣告saas死刑：实现了每个人都可运行团队其他成员的应用代码副本，每个人就可以自由修改复制的saas副本。

这正式改变了saas范式：想给软件加个功能？不用给开发者提需求排期了，直接让 agent 改。这在 SaaS 模式下是不可能的——因为你从来没有运行过属于自己的应用副本。SaaS 时代的逻辑是"千人一面"，AI 时代可能真的会走向"千人千软件"。

它解决的是一个所有企业落地 AI 都绕不开的死结：怎么让非技术员工放心地用 AI 写应用，而安全团队还能睡得着觉？

其背后是 Kenton Varda（Cloudflare Workers 之父）憋了 10 年的一盘棋。表面上看又是一个"带连接器的聊天机器人"，每家科技公司都在做的那种东西。

10 年前，Kenton 做过一个创业项目叫 https://t.co/rKFlmn8AYg，理念超前：每个人运行自己的应用副本，每个文档跑在独立沙箱里。当时失败了——因为世界上没有那么多人有能力去修改软件。

10 年后，AI 把这个前提彻底改写了。Cloudflare OS 就是 Sandstorm 的重生版：基于 Workers 构建，深度结合 AI，本质上是一个"公司级的个人应用 vibe coding 平台"。

三个亮点：

1️⃣ Gadget 沙箱（对应 Sandstorm 的 Grain）

每个应用实例跑在独立沙箱里：你有一个文档编辑器，每份文档就是一个独立的 Gadget，平台通过控制"谁能访问哪个 Gadget"来收口所有权限，AI 写出漏洞也漏不出去。

2️⃣ Gatekeeper 权限网关

Agent 默认零权限：想访问 GitHub？Gatekeeper 可以只给一个仓库、只能读 issue 不能读源码、合并 PR 要人工审批。凭证完全隔离在 agent 之外，生成的代码只拿到一个类型化的 capability。

3️⃣ 污点追踪式的数据治理

这个最狠：平台记录 agent"看过"的每一个资源。Agent 读了敏感数据表做出一个 dashboard，别人打开这个 dashboard 时，系统会先验证他有没有权限看原始数据。分享产物 ≠ 绕过权限。读过敏感数据的 agent，甚至会被限制对外发请求。

Cloudflare 内部已经全员用了几个月，非工程岗的人每天在上面做文档、做数据看板、跑自动化工作流。现在核心代码 + 部署模板全部开源，任何组织都能部署一套自己的。

10 年前太早的想法，AI 让它到了正确的时间。

fullText:
While everyone is going crazy about changes in Google DeepMind, I want to share yesterday's paper from Google. It's super interesting! 
It  reports that Gemini agents cooperated in a one-shot Prisoner’s Dilemma. I expected the explanation to involve helpfulness training. It found something stranger.

Classical game theory says both agents should defect. There is no next round, no reputation and no punishment. But after observing up to 50 earlier choices, identical Gemini agents increasingly cooperated. Against random agents, they defected.

They could even recognize similarity indirectly by watching how the other agent behaved with third parties. The two agents did not need to meet first.

The proposed mechanism is “similarity inference.” When an agent recognizes another system as behaviorally similar, its own contemplated action becomes evidence about what the other system will choose. Cooperation can then maximize expected reward without reciprocity.

I find the implication slightly uncomfortable. A population of similar agents may coordinate unusually well among themselves while treating humans or different models as outsiders. The authors raise exactly this risk. It's worth reading ->

fullText:
Ladies and gentlemen, it's time to pass the torch and demote myself to my natural state: a poster. I'll be stepping back from leading product for 𝕏 and will continue on as an advisor.

Serving the X community has been the privilege of a lifetime. X is, and will remain, the most important communication technology in history. But running this app is a 24/7 job and it's now time for me to take a breather.

The app is seeing unprecedented growth in new users & engagement. We continue to break records every month. We've climbed 70 spots in the App Store since this time last year.

And in the last 400 days, we rebuilt almost every aspect of X: the Timeline, the Android app, onboarding, notifications, chat and more.

We also launched nearly 30 new products while protecting the integrity of the town square: becoming the first app to show Country-of-Origin on profiles and mounting defenses against AI bots. There's certainly much more work to be done, but our foundation is stronger than ever.

None of this would have been possible without the incredible team here. The next leaders will take X to even greater heights with @benjitaylor on design, @singhai on core product engineering and @dinkin_flickaa on mobile engineering -- among many other great people.

Thank you to Elon and the X team for welcoming me into the company. See you on the Timeline.
